tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Live availability and price comparison for one exact domain (e.g. "acme.io") across registrars. Returns per-registrar registration, renewal and transfer prices, premium status, and a recommendation based on 2-year total cost.

tools.name: check_name_across_tlds
tools.description: Check one name (e.g. "acme") across several TLDs at once and return availability plus the best 2-year price for each. Defaults to .com, .net, .io, .ai, .dev, .app. Max 8 TLDs per call.

tools.name: compare_tld_prices
tools.description: Standard (non-premium) prices for one TLD across registrars, refreshed daily, sorted by 2-year cost. Use for general questions like "how much is a .io domain"; use check_domain for a specific name.

tools.name: recommend_names
tools.description: Given a short project description, recommend 3-5 TLDs (best fit first, with reasons) and 10 brandable names, each screened for availability on the top 3 TLDs (or up to 3 the user picks) with the cheapest standard 2-year cost. tools.name: brand_check
tools.description: Check whether a name is free as a handle on GitHub, npm, PyPI, crates.io and YouTube, with links to check X, Instagram and TikTok by hand, plus links to the USPTO and WIPO trademark databases. Not legal advice.

tools.name: check_renewals
tools.description: For domains the user already owns (up to 20): current registrar, expiry date, renewal price, and the cheapest registrar to transfer to, with the two-year saving. tools.name: taken_domain_options

tools.name: compare_email_hosting

tools.description: Announced registry (wholesale) price increases, upcoming and from the past year, plus changes to registrar standard prices seen in TLDMath’s daily checks. Use for "is .com going up?" or "should I renew early?". Optionally filter by TLD.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_renewals, plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps, ownership_card, plan_app_move · Private data: plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps, ownership_card, plan_app_move, compare_app_email · Public sink: check_renewals, taken_domain_options, compare_email_hosting, plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps, ownership_card, compare_app_email · Destructive: recommend_names, taken_domain_options, plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_renewals, plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps, ownership_card, plan_app_move · Private data: plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps, ownership_card, plan_app_move, compare_app_email · Public sink: check_renewals, taken_domain_options, compare_email_hosting, plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps, ownership_card, compare_app_email · Destructive: recommend_names, taken_domain_options, plan_dns_setup, plan_launch_steps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
